app.name: GovPath AI
app.disclaimer: GovPath AI is an informational guide. It does not submit applications, guarantee eligibility or give legal advice. Requirements come from official sources verified on the dates shown; always confirm on the official website before applying.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Plan the steps, documents and order needed to update your address across Indian government services.

services.title: Government services
services.intro: Verified requirements for government services, taken from official sources. Search or filter by life event.
services.loadError: Could not load the service information.
services.searchPlaceholder: Search by service, authority or keyword…
services.noVerifiedInEvent: No services in this life event have been verified yet.
services.coverageNote: GovPath only lists services whose requirements are verified from official sources.

planner.title: Workflow planner
planner.intro: Choose the services you need and tick the documents you already have. GovPath works out the order, what is missing and what to do next.
planner.step2Hint: Tick the documents you already have, such as records being updated and proofs that already show the right details.
planner.selectServiceFirst: Select a service to see the documents it accepts.
planner.tickWhenYouHaveIt: Tick a document once you have it, and the plan will update:
planner.deterministicNote: This plan is calculated by fixed rules from verified official requirements, not by AI.
planner.parallelHint_other: {{count}} independent steps: do them in any order or at the same time
planner.noDependencies: Does not depend on any other step.
planner.missingNoRoute: You need one of these documents. No service in GovPath issues them, so obtain any one yourself.
planner.autoUpdate: The plan updates automatically when you change your selections.
planner.emptyTitle: Select at least one service to begin
planner.emptyHint: Then tick the documents you have and press “Generate my plan”.
planner.unknownIds: Some saved selections are no longer available. Remove them and recalculate?
planner.planError: The plan could not be calculated.
planner.alsoWaiting: Also on hold until these are resolved: {{services}}.

documents.title: Documents
documents.intro: Every document GovPath knows about, which services accept it, and which services issue it.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask questions in plain English or Hindi. Answers are AI-generated explanations grounded in official government sources, with citations.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. Which documents prove my new address for a passport reissue?
assistant.usePlan: Use my saved plan from the planner
assistant.searching: Searching official sources and preparing an answer…
assistant.example1: Which documents can I use as proof of address for Aadhaar?
assistant.example2: Do I need to update Aadhaar before changing my voter ID address?
assistant.example3: What do I need to change the address on my vehicle RC?
assistant.quotaNote: The assistant uses a limited free AI quota. Repeated questions are answered from cache.
assistant.empty: Ask a question to get an explanation with official sources.
assistant.disclaimer: AI-generated explanation based on the official sources above. It is not an official government decision; please verify on the official website.
assistant.planContext: From your plan (calculated by fixed rules, not AI):

home.title: Know what to do, in what order, with which documents
home.subtitle: GovPath AI turns life events, such as moving home, getting married or having a child, into a personal checklist of government services. Every requirement is backed by official sources.
home.coverage_one: {{count}} government service verified from official sources
home.coverage_other: {{count}} government services verified from official sources
home.lifeEventsHint: Choose what is happening in your life to see the services that may apply.
home.how1Text: Choose the services you need from any life event.
home.how2Text: Mark the documents you already have. Alternatives count.
home.how3Text: See the order, blockers and next step. Ask the assistant for explanations with sources.
home.savedEmpty: You have not started a plan yet. Your selections are saved on this device when you do.
home.trustText: Requirements are taken from official government websites and documents, quoted exactly and dated. The planner uses fixed rules; the assistant only explains them. Coverage is limited to the services listed here.
